===Filling===
A regular compost bin must be filled with 15 un-noted items before it can be closed to begin the rotting process.
The big compost bin in the Farming Guild requires 30 items instead.
Items cannot be retrieved from the bin once deposited, though the contents can be dumped out to discard them.
Once closed, the bin cannot be opened until the rotting finishes after 35 to 70 minutes.

What the compost bin produces depends on the items that were used:
*[[Rotten tomato]]es if the bin was entirely filled with [[tomato]]es.
*[[Supercompost]] if the bin was entirely filled with ''supercompostable'' items.
*Regular [[compost]] if neither of the above apply.

Most harvested products of Farming can be added to a compost bin.
In general, a product is supercompostable if and only if growing it requires 47 [[Farming]] or higher, but several exceptions apply:
* [[Potato cactus]] and [[cotton boll]] require greater than 47 Farming, but produce normal compost.
* [[Toadflax]] and some [[tree roots (Farming)|tree roots]] do not require 47 Farming, but are supercompostable.
* [[White tree fruit]] does not require 47 Farming, but requires completion of [[Garden of Tranquillity]] and is supercompostable.
* [[Cactus spine]]s, [[nightshade]], and all kinds of tree logs cannot be composted.

Items which are derived from products of Farming may or may not be compostable.
For instance, [[watermelon slice]]s are compostable, but [[pineapple ring]]s are not.
Any item may be used on a [[Group of Advanced Gardeners|farmer]] to check whether the item will make compost or supercompost.
If the item does not make compost at all, the message {{mes|Nothing interesting happens.}} is displayed instead.

Because every item added must be supercompostable for the bin to produce supercompost, a warning dialogue appears if the player attempts to mix compostable and supercompostable items.

On normal worlds, compost bins can be filled while simultaneously harvesting a nearby allotment. Stand close to the bin and the nearest allotment patch, harvest a single crop, then click the allotment and use the crop already in your inventory on the bin in the same game tick. This does not work on [[PvP world]]s or [[Deadman Mode]] worlds.
